questions.title: What does this system do, and what must it protect?
questions.explain: Describe the business outcome and the impact of misuse.

questions.title: Who uses or supplies data to this system?
questions.explain: Include operators and external systems, not only application users.

questions.title: What is the highest sensitivity of the data?
questions.explain: Record what data is involved; do not paste actual personal data or secrets.

questions.title: Does the system separate different customers or tenants?
questions.explain: A shared AWS account does not establish tenant isolation.

questions.title: How is access between tenants prevented?
questions.explain: Describe the enforcement point and tests, not just a tenant ID field.

questions.title: Which identities may access this component?
questions.explain: Capture intended access. This importer does not evaluate IAM.

questions.title: Are this component’s permissions limited to its task?
questions.explain: Name the permissions and scope to review. A declaration is not a verified control.

questions.title: Does this flow cross a trust boundary?
questions.explain: Compare identity, owner, tenant, exposure and isolation. Zone colors alone are not proof.

questions.title: How is the sender authenticated at this boundary?
questions.explain: Identify the receiving enforcement point and identity.

questions.title: How are untrusted payloads and replayed messages handled?
questions.explain: Describe validation, size limits and replay protection.

questions.title: Are retries, duplicates, failures and dead-letter handling bounded?
questions.explain: Record retry budgets, idempotency and DLQ tests.

questions.title: What evidence would demonstrate the intended controls?
questions.explain: List tests, captures and owners. This answer does not verify those controls.
